# ICSE SEET 2027 — Topics of Interest

Contributions may address any level or context (primary/secondary, undergraduate, graduate, coding clubs, hackathons, bootcamps, industrial training, informal learning). Topics include, but are not limited to:

1. Emerging SE education topics covering **AI for Software Engineering**
2. Emerging SE education topics covering **Software Engineering for AI**
3. Foundational research on software engineering skills
4. Methods of teaching software engineering skills
5. Methods of evaluating, assessing, and measuring software engineering skills
6. Evaluation and assessment in software engineering education
7. Evaluations of teaching and assessment methods
8. Empirical studies describing SE education contexts
9. Pedagogical approaches for distributed and remote settings
10. Learning technologies and tools supporting SE education and training
11. Intersectionality in SE education, with emphasis on at-risk groups (primary/secondary children, adult learners, marginalized communities) and barriers to equitable access
12. Automated evaluation of software engineering skills
13. Role of soft skills (communication, collaboration, teamwork, organization, negotiation, conflict management)
14. Studies of equity, diversity, and inclusion in SE education and training
15. Ethical and societal concerns (e.g., sustainability, human values) in SE education
16. Onboarding and on-the-job training of software engineers
17. Continuing education of software engineers
18. Extra-curricular training (e.g., hackathons, bootcamps)
19. Certification and training for professional software engineers
20. Use of online platforms and resources for SE education
21. Synergy between academia and industry in SE education and training
